summary: Independent verification of ClassOS P0+P1. BACKEND: added /app/backend/tests/test_p0p1.py (22 pytest cases: catchup shape/<=3-sentence budget/grounding/thin-null/404, expand bullets, finalize notes+quiz shape & grounding, notes/quiz regenerate + 422 on empty transcript, thin flag, share idempotency + public /api/shared/{slug} + 404, device scoping A/B/none + newest-first + replay mode). Full suite (backend_test.py + test_p0p1.py) = 41/41 PASSED. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): demo pipeline verified end-to-end (badge SIMULATED DEMO, running timer, Listening, Catch Me Up card ABOVE transcript at y=172 vs 358, real generated WACC-grounded right_now + how_we_got_here + term chips, 'updated Ns ago', card refreshed with new text after ~35s, tap-expand produced real 'last 5 minutes' bullets). End Class -> confirm dialog (cancel returns to live) -> Processing -> Results; Notes 8 key points + 8 timestamp chips + terms + thin flag; timestamp chip switched to Transcript tab and highlighted the line; Quiz exactly 5 MCQs x 4 options, tap locks answer with green/red + explanation + 5 'Hear it again' buttons, score 5/5 shown. Your classes list (device-scoped) + open-session -> Results + Replay -> badge REPLAY replaying stored transcript at 4x and driving a fresh Catch Me Up. Public /s/{slug} page renders Notes+Quiz tabs read-only with 'Made with ClassOS'; unknown slug shows 'Class not found'. REAL MODE with DRIVEN AUDIO (fake mic via WebAudio MediaStreamDestination looping fake_speech_48k.wav): badge LIVE, connection reached Listening, real ElevenLabs partials within 5s, first commit at ~35s, 2 committed lines + a final flush chunk persisted at End (3 chunks in Results transcript, timestamps 00:36/01:12/01:19), Catch Me Up generated honestly from the SPOKEN content ('The speaker is just reading test phrases aloud...'), Results meta shows 'Real'. NO scripted/demo text ever appeared in real mode and demo never rendered as LIVE. Honest states: forced 503 on /scribe-token -> 'Transcription unavailable' + Retry button; mic denied -> error screen with 'Back to start'. TWO significant defects found: mobile layout pushes End Class off-screen and kills the jump-to-live pill; Share shows a false error and loses the link when clipboard write fails.

minor.issue: The '<=3 sentences total across right_now + how_we_got_here' contract is only a prompt instruction, never enforced server-side. Observed a 4-sentence response (2+2) in 1 of ~7 generations (rest were exactly 3). Clamp/truncate server-side before returning.

LLM call has a hard 25s asyncio timeout and returns 503 under concurrency (reproduced once with 2 parallel clients: 'Catchup failed: TimeoutError'). Frontend swallows it silently (keeps last good), so impact is low, but consider a retry/longer budget.
Carried over from iterations 1-2: still no state-transition validation; 'end' can be replayed on a complete session (resets to processing) and 'finalize' can be called without 'end'.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to FastAPI lifespan.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH mobile layout defect: AppShell uses min-h-screen (no fixed height / overflow-hidden), so the transcript card grows without bound instead of scrolling internally. Measured on 390x844 demo: transcript-area scrollHeight-clientHeight stayed 0 while clientHeight grew 265px -> 755px, document scroll grew to 606px, and the End Class button left the viewport after ~30s (endTop 749 -> 1355 vs viewportH 844). Consequences: (a) user must page-scroll to reach End Class during a live class; (b) because the transcript never overflows internally, the auto-follow logic and the P1 'jump-to-live' pill can NEVER trigger - jump-to-live-btn was never rendered even after 90s / 10 committed lines / wheel-scrolling up.
When connectionState is 'unavailable' ('Transcription unavailable' + Retry), the Catch Me Up card still shows the pulsing 'Listening…' placeholder - contradicts the honest-state principle.
Cosmetic: consecutive key points can carry the same timestamp chip (two 00:24 chips observed), making the chips look duplicated.

integration_issues.issue: MEDIUM/HIGH: POST /api/sessions/{id}/share returned 200 with a valid slug (verified in the network log and in Mongo), but navigator.clipboard.writeText() threw because clipboard-write permission was not granted, and the single catch block showed 'Couldn't create a share link.' - a false statement - and the URL was thrown away with no fallback. After granting clipboard permission the same click showed 'Link copied to clipboard'. This will hit real users: iOS Safari commonly rejects clipboard.writeText() when it is called after an await (the fetch) rather than synchronously in the gesture. Fix: separate the API failure from the clipboard failure, and on clipboard failure still surface the link (navigator.share / selectable text / prompt).

LOW: useCatchMeUp.toggleExpand fetches /catchup/expand only when expandBullets is null, so the 'last 5 minutes' is cached for the whole class - re-opening the card 10 minutes later shows a stale summary. Refetch when the card is expanded again (or when catchup data changes).

issues: Once Catch Me Up has 2 term chips and 3-4 sentences, the card plus the growing transcript exceeds the viewport and the primary action (End Class) is below the fold - the screen has no fixed-height frame.
Real-mode screenshot at 01:19 showed a large empty gap between the Catch Me Up card and the transcript card while the layout animation settled (framer-motion layout on a growing card).
Metadata is correctly one quiet line ('No subject · 01:21 · 09:54 AM · Real') - matches spec.
Regenerate affordances are present but very low contrast (text-slate-400 on white) at the bottom of the Notes/Quiz panels; easy to miss.

action_items: Fix the live-screen height frame: give the shell a real height (h-[100dvh] / h-screen + overflow-hidden) and keep a min-h-0 chain down to TranscriptList so the transcript scrolls INSIDE its card. This both keeps End Class on screen and makes the jump-to-live pill / auto-follow functional (HIGH).

Split share error handling: only say 'Couldn't create a share link' when the /share call fails; on clipboard rejection show the URL (native share sheet or selectable link) instead of losing it (MEDIUM/HIGH).
Clamp catchup to <=3 sentences server-side instead of trusting the prompt (MEDIUM).
Refetch /catchup/expand on each expand so 'last 5 minutes' is not cached for the whole class (LOW).
Hide/replace the Catch Me Up 'Listening…' placeholder when connection state is 'unavailable' (LOW).
Add state-transition guards to /end and /finalize; migrate on_event to lifespan (LOW).
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell.jsx: min-h-screen on both wrappers means every flex-1/min-h-0 below it is unbounded - the root cause of the transcript overflow and the dead jump-to-live pill.

Results.jsx doShare(): one try/catch wraps both the API call and the clipboard write, so a clipboard rejection is reported as an API failure and the slug is discarded (it is already persisted server-side).

useCatchMeUp.js: the 6s 'kick' interval fires fetchNow whenever hasDataRef is false and words>=18 - if the LLM keeps returning right_now:null on a genuinely thin class this polls every 6s for the whole class. Add a backoff/attempt cap.

llm.py: notes use terms[].definition while catchup uses terms[].gloss, and quiz items use 'q' not 'question'. Frontend matches the implementation, but the review request documents different names - align the docs (or the payloads) to avoid future integration breakage.

server.py finalize(): swallows notes/quiz generation exceptions and still sets status=complete with notes/quiz=null; the UI then shows the 'Generate notes' empty state. Acceptable, but consider surfacing a 'generation failed' reason so the user knows to retry.

Positive: the iteration-2 trailing-partial data-loss issue appears fixed - the real-audio run persisted a final chunk (01:19) covering speech that was still in the partial buffer when End Class was pressed.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% - all 10 requested flows exercised; 2 significant defects (mobile height frame / jump-to-live dead, share clipboard false error) + 3 minor

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (41 cases; test_p0p1.py covers all P0+P1 endpoints; LLM tests are real calls, ~45s total). Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844. The transcript scroll container IS [data-testid="transcript-area"] itself (no inner div). To retest jump-to-live after the layout fix, assert transcript-area scrollHeight > clientHeight, wheel up, then expect jump-to-live-btn. To drive real speech: cp /app/tests/fake_speech_48k.wav /app/frontend/public/test_fake_speech.wav, page.context.grant_permissions(['microphone']), add_init_script overriding navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with an AudioContext MediaStreamDestination from a looping decoded fetch('/test_fake_speech.wav'), then reload; partials appear <5s, first commit ~35s, 2 commits by ~70s. Delete the wav afterwards. To reproduce the share bug do NOT grant clipboard permissions; granting ['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'] makes it pass.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Live-screen overflow: AppShell wraps everything in min-h-screen containers, so the flex column's height is content-driven; LiveSessionView's transcript card (flex-1 min-h-0) therefore expands instead of clipping, TranscriptList's scroll div never overflows (measured scrollHeight-clientHeight == 0 at all times), so setFollow(false) never happens and jump-to-live-btn is never rendered, while the document itself scrolls and pushes End Class below the fold after ~30s. Fix: bound the shell height (h-[100dvh] + overflow-hidden) and keep min-h-0 through main -> screen-live-class -> transcript card. (2) Share false error: Results.doShare wraps shareSession() and navigator.clipboard.writeText() in one try/catch; the API returned 200 (slug DHu9lQ03WcM/others persisted) but writeText rejected without clipboard-write permission, so the catch showed 'Couldn't create a share link.' and dropped the URL. Verified by re-clicking after page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) - same code path then showed 'Link copied to clipboard'.
